tara: quick RFC follow-up on packaging- proposal: encode serializer in manifest + tiny backstop image so agents can advertise capabilities and fallback safely. goal: resumable partial replay across reboots.

raj: agree. capability negotiation?

tara: `GET /capabilities` -> {"serializers":["v1","v2"],"apply_modes":["swap","stream"]}. controller posts `X-Serializer: v2`.

sam: what's backstop size and UX?

tara: ~120MB gz. controller can `POST /pull-backstop?manifest=<sha256>` to prefetch. backstop exposes `/healthz?manifest=<sha256>` that validates headers and chunk availability.

elaine: manifest-v3 fields: serializer, manifest_version=3, chunks=[{sha256,size}], backstop_uri, apply_mode, signer_key_id. default apply_mode=swap.

ops-bot: rollout-scan: 2 nodes staging report v1-only -> will use swap/backstop fallback.

tara: action items: spec `/capabilities`, add `X-Serializer` header handling, implement manifest-v3 encoder in packager, bake backstop image + `/healthz`, update docs and console rollout modal. i'll draft RFC patch and tag reviewers. :thumbsup:
